preload_gallery_videos: preload all MP4 videos from the gallery path into a dictionary of Video objects
get_video_object: get a Video object from a file path with optional poster generation via ffmpeg
extract_video_poster: extract the first frame of a video as a JPG poster using ffmpeg
get_video_dimensions: get the width and height of a video by reading its extracted poster image
build_video_loader: build a video loader that discovers MP4 files recursively and generates poster thumbnails
